thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-4521 — auth-service - JWT verification errors spike (token validation failure rate >50%)

pagerduty: Incident created: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4521 (auto-escalation enabled)

alex (on-call): acked. I'm on it. pulling metrics now.

jamie (sre): seeing auth-service 5xxs across EU/US regions. Error is "invalid_signature" on JWT validation. Spike started ~02:13 UTC. Recent deploy? :thinking_face: 

wei (backend): no deploys to auth-service in last 12h. There was a key rotation job at 02:12 UTC by key-rotation cron.

priaya (eng-security): pinging key rotation pipeline owners. Could be a bad JWKS published.

alex (on-call): can someone curl the JWKS endpoint and paste? If clients have tokens with kid X but JWKS missing that kid -> validation fails.

jamie (sre): run:
```
curl -s https://auth.redwood.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .
```
response (truncated):
```
{"keys":[{"kty":"RSA","use":"sig","kid":"k-main-202402","alg":"RS256"}]}
```
clients' tokens show kid: k-main-202403 (different)

wei (backend): confirmed tokens in logs with kid=k-main-202403. Looks like rotation job created new key but JWKS only serving the previous one — kid mismatch.

priaya (eng-security): escalate to oncall-keyops. Possible race in rotation service: new key inserted to DB but JWKS cache not invalidated.

alex (on-call): mitigation plan: 1) force JWKS to include previous + new key, 2) short-term rollback rotation job, 3) flush any JWKS caches (CDN/edge). I'll attempt to add missing key to JWKS quickly.

jamie (sre): instructions to ops: kubectl exec into jwks-service pod, run: 
```
# regenerate JWKS from DB including both keys
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/reload-jwks
```

wei (backend): pushed reload endpoint call, response 200. JWKS now returning both keys:
```
{"keys":[{"kid":"k-main-202402"},{"kid":"k-main-202403"}]}
```

alex (on-call): monitoring auth error rate... dropping. :thumbsup: 

pagerduty: PD#INC-4521 acknowledged by alex (on-call).

support-bot: Posting initial customer impact to #customer-impact: "Some API auth failures between 02:13-02:26 UTC affecting token validation for clients using recently rotated tokens. Workaround applied; monitoring."

maria (csm): flagged top-3 enterprise customers for direct emails.

priaya (eng-security): root cause hypothesis: rotation pipeline wrote new key without updating JWKS cache eviction / propagation. Follow-up: add end-to-end check to rotation job and increase cache TTL invalidation. Also add canary traffic for key publishing.

jamie (sre): rolling back rotation job for safety: kubectl rollout undo deployment/key-rotation -n auth

wei (backend): rollback applied at 02:25 UTC. Rotation job disabled temporarily.

alex (on-call): auth validation errors back to baseline. Closing PD. Will create postmortem and schedule follow-up with key-rotation owners and eng-security. ETA postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.

pagerduty: Incident resolved and closed by alex (on-call). :white_check_mark:

priaya (eng-security): tagging eng-sre, eng-platform for follow-up. We'll include timeline, root cause, mitigation, and remediation plan.

alex (on-call): +1. Thanks team. Good job moving fast. We'll keep a small follow-up meeting in 24h. :coffee:
